lines: Who stands in scriptures Vaiṣṇava to southern tantra-end, or holds their vows,
even highest-scripture men serving unentitled lower gurus —
when the Lord's descent turns them hither, then this is their rule:
fast-observed next day, common-worshipped, doings told, led before the Lord;
vow taken, cast in water; bathed, sprinkled, gruel-and-toothstick-purified,
blindfold led in, by common mantra let the Lord be worshipped.
sanskrit_cite: vaiṣṇavādidakṣiṇatantrānteṣu śāsaneṣu ye sthitāḥ tadgṛhītavratā vā ye ca uttamaśāsanasthā api anadhikṛtādharaśāsanagurūpasevinaḥ te yadā śaktipātena pārameśvareṇa unmukhīkriyante tadā teṣām ayaṃ vidhiḥ tatra enaṃ kṛtopavāsam anyadine sādhāraṇamantrapūjitasya tadīyāṃ ceṣṭāṃ śrāvitasya bhagavato 'gre praveśayet tatrāsya vrataṃ gṛhītvā ambhasi kṣipet tato 'sau snāyāt tataḥ prokṣya carudantakāṣṭhābhyāṃ saṃskṛtya baddhanetraṃ praveśya sādhāraṇena mantreṇa parameśvarapūjāṃ kārayet

lines: Then let the vow be made pure in fire-turned-Śiva by the common chant;
name coffined in his own chant — "I cleanse the penance," svāhā-sealed — a hundred poured.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sādhāraṇamantreṇa śivīkṛte agnau vrataśuddhiṃ kuryāt tanmantrasampuṭaṃ nāma kṛtvā prāyaścittaṃ śodhayāmi iti svāhāntaṃ śataṃ juhuyāt

lines: Then too the full oblation, vauṣaṭ-ending.
Then invoke the Vow-lord, worship, and by Śiva's order — 'be thou his no-harmer' —
having announced, satisfied, dismissed him, dismiss the fire. Thus liṅga-lifting.
sanskrit_cite: tato vrateśvaram āhūya pūjayitvā tasya śivājñayā akiṃcitkaraḥ tvam asya bhava iti śrāvaṇāṃ kṛtvā taṃ tarpayitvā visṛjya agniṃ visṛjet iti liṅgoddhāraḥ

lines: Then his dwelling-over and the rest, as before.
